parsed_output.reasoning_summary: This arm is a didactic 'how science works' text emphasizing the concreteness and precision of climate measurement (ice cores, volcanic-ash dating, isotopes, OCO-2 satellite, the 'drop of ink in an Olympic pool' analogy). Its main mechanism is boosting perceived COMPETENCE and methodological rigor, plus some benevolence/openness via the image of dedicated fieldwork; it does not address funding, conflicts of interest, or accusations of bias, so integrity gains should be indirect and no reactance is expected. I therefore forecast a solidly positive but not top-tier primary effect (~2 points, d≈0.09), with the fresh multidimensional battery moving more than the pre-anchored single trust and belief items. Downstream outcomes are attenuated in the expected order: modest transfer to institutional trust (NASA is named explicitly) and to the legitimacy of scientists informing assessments/policy, smaller effects on belief and concern (the text is evidentiary but not alarming or normative), and sub-point effects on policy and behavioral intentions. Funding perceptions get a small lift because the text implicitly justifies the expense of observation infrastructure. Incentivized outcomes are near zero, with a slight nudge for the American Meteorological Society donation given the measurement/monitoring framing.
